notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with browser UA) succeeded for robots.txt, sitemap.xml, homepage, and all collection pages - no block encountered, no Playwright/Chrome needed. www.housedoctor.com 301-redirects to housedoctor.com; working domain used for all fetches. robots.txt is a Shopify agent-facing file (User-agent: * / Allow: /), no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow. TREE: built from the site's 'Products' mega-menu (canonical product-type hierarchy, extracted from header <nav> HTML) plus the collections sitemap for cross-check, plus each sub-brand's own on-page nav (Meraki and Nicolas Vahe pages, both sold on this same storefront, have their own full category trees reachable from the Brands tab). The 'Rooms' mega-menu (Entrance/Kitchen/Dining area/Living room/Bathroom/Bedroom/Wardrobe/Outdoor) was intentionally NOT used as a separate tree - it links to the exact same /collections/ URLs already captured under Products, just re-sliced by room, so following it would only create duplicate rows (per rule: room name never drives classification). QTY: each collection page renders an exact 'N products' count in the page body above the product grid (verified reliable - Home textiles parent showed 127 and its 6 child collections summed to exactly 127, confirming the count is not inflated/estimated). Used that literal number for qty; used the 'no products in this collection' message for confirmed qty=0. EXCLUDED and why: bags-purses-shoppers (1 product, a 'Clutch' - fashion/personal-carry item, not home storage, despite being nav-placed under Storage); knobs-handles (0 products; furniture/cabinet hardware, not a storage product, analogous to curtain-rod hardware exclusion); trolleys (12 products, all rolling utility/shelving carts - excluded because the site explicitly nav-places 'Trolleys' under its Furniture group, and storage.md SS21 says defer to an explicit Furniture placement); bookcases-shelving and cabinets-sideboards (both nav-placed under Furniture group - excluded per same rule); wardrobe (157 products - a Rooms-only aggregator landing page that recombines natural-baskets/fabric-baskets/bags/racks-hangers-hooks/knobs-handles/bookcases-shelving already counted individually elsewhere - not a distinct subcategory, dropped as a View-All-style aggregate); curtains and all bynord-* collections (bed-linen/pillowcases/sheets/bedding/throws/rugs/cushion-covers etc.) - all confirmed via direct fetch to show 'Sorry, there are no products in this collection' AND none are linked anywhere in the live Products/Rooms mega-menu or any collection page (grep across all fetched HTML found zero references) - these are orphaned/discontinued sitemap-only collections, not part of the live site tree, so excluded entirely rather than recorded as qty=0; all Meraki sub-collections outside Textiles/Storage/Towels-cloths-robes (meraki-bags: mostly makeup pouches/toiletry bags = personal-care carry items, not home storage, excluded per same boundary as bags-purses-shoppers; meraki-trays-jars: decorative trays/soap dishes/jars, primarily decorative not storage, excluded per storage.md SS24) and all other Meraki collections (Body/Hair/Face/Feet/Home fragrance/Candles/Decor/Gifting) which are cosmetics/decor, out of scope; all Nicolas Vahe food collections (Salty/Sweet Kitchen, Spices, Jam, etc.) and Kitchen Accessories/Cutlery/Kitchen Utensils/Tableware - food and Kitchen & Dining boundary, out of scope. Two leaf nodes flagged for review: 'Cushion filling' (pillow/duvet stuffing material rather than a finished textile piece - included at MEDIUM confidence because the site itself nests it under Home textiles) and 'Outdoor textiles' (genuine nav-linked Textile category, currently 0 products, kept at MEDIUM since a 0-qty leaf is inherently harder to verify than a populated one). Grouping rows used only for nodes that are themselves a named Storage/Home-textiles category in the site's own nav (Products > Storage, Products > Home textiles, Meraki > Storage/Textiles, Nicolas Vahe > Baskets & Storage/Textiles & Napkins); leaves reached only via an unrelated parent (e.g. Kitchen accessories > Kitchen storage, Bathroom accessories > Bathroom storage/Laundry baskets, Home Office > Storage) were recorded as flat top-level rows rather than fabricating an out-of-scope parent (Kitchen accessories, Bathroom accessories, Home Office are not themselves Textile/Storage categories).
